survey: A blue stockless-style anchor, tilted slightly and seen from the front. At the top a round ring sits on the head of the shank. Below it a horizontal stock with ball ends passes through a square collar on the shank. The straight shank runs down to the crown, where two curved arms end in pointed flukes, left and right. A tan twisted rope loops through the ring, runs down the shank past the stock collar, wraps around the shank about twice, and its lower end stops at the crown. The anchor floats on a plain striped background, which is normal for an icon.

errors.where: lower end of the rope, at the crown where the arms meet the shank
errors.what: The rope's last coil runs into the crown and stops there. It has no tail, knot or tie point, so the rope looks fused into the metal instead of ending in a real way.

errors.where: rope at the stock collar below the ring
errors.what: The rope comes down from the ring and seems to go under the tight square collar of the stock, then comes out below it. A rope can't pass between a fitted collar and the shank; it should run in front of or behind the stock.

fix: Rope tied through the anchor ring, running in front of the crossbar stock (not under its collar), coiled twice around the shank, with a short loose frayed tail hanging free near the crown instead of merging into the metal.
